label: TP
reason: This case is labeled TP due to the presence of critical vulnerabilities identified by multiple alerts. Seven java/stack-trace-exposure alerts (Lines 128, 134, 140, 146, 152, 158, 164) reveal that exception stack traces are printed directly to the HTTP response, potentially exposing sensitive server-side information to users. Two java/weak-cryptographic-algorithm alerts (Lines 79, 81) confirm the use of the deprecated DES algorithm, which is insecure. While the java/xss alert (Lines 116-122) identifies user input flowing to the response, the code applies encodeForHTML mitigation, making that specific alert a False Positive (FP). The confirmed stack trace and weak crypto risks drive the case to TP.

evidence.note: Stack trace printed to response.getWriter() exposes sensitive info (TP)
User input flows to sink but is mitigated by encodeForHTML (FP)
